name: Atsu's Father
source:
The overprotective father of [url=https://vndb.org/c21956]Atsu[/url]. He lost his wife sometime after the birth of his daughter and he has been educating him since. His personality is surprisingly surprising.

He is particularly angry at [url=https://vndb.org/c77251]Seiji[/url] for the accident of 10 years ago and when he learns that he and his daughter have become more than friends, his protective paternal instinct is doubly on the move in order to intimidate him as much as possible against the one who wants to take away his daughter from him.

[spoiler]When Seiji goes out with Atsu, they will spend an evening with Atsu's father in which he heavily abused alcohol. Thinking he was in a deep sleep, Seiji and Atsu make love, but he wakes up because he wants to pee and he surprises the two love birds at the very end of their act. He then congratulates his daughter for her futur baby (always drunk), which makes Seiji laugh a lot.[/spoiler]
